params.prompt: Edit reference image 1. Keep the exact composition of reference image 1: the open-plan office, the black-and-gold robots working at the desks, the empty office chair and the cardboard box with belongings in the sharp foreground. Change the time to blue hour: outside the windows a deep teal-blue city with lit skyscrapers; inside, warm orange desk lamps; the robots' monitors glow with magenta, cyan and orange charts. Cinematic teal-and-orange color grading with magenta accents. Make the upper 45% of the frame (ceiling, sky, top of the windows) much darker - deep navy to near-black - so a white headline on top reads perfectly. Rich saturated colors, high contrast, cinematic. No text, no letters, no logos.
